To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the computer modeling of arterial pressure waveforms provides an effective tool for evaluating the respiratory influences on cardiovascular system and that aging impairs the baroreflex mechanism.

1) a computer model was developed to study the magnitude and phase relations between pleural pressure and arterial pressure in response of respiratory fluctuations; 2) the computer model provided good fit to arterial pressure waveform; 3) aging was found to impair baroreflex mechanism; 4) no dominant parameter was identified in terms of phase relations.
the computer model can provide good fits to arterial waveform, and that aging impairs the baroreflex mechanism.
